facts.label: Obrigações com have to
facts.sub: Use have to + verbo base para obrigações: I have to work. Com he, she ou it, use has to: My boss has to read it. Nesta aula, só a forma afirmativa.

facts.label: Obrigações
facts.sub: Para falar de obrigações, use have to + verbo base: I have to work. Com he, she ou it, use has to: She has to finish it. Depois de to, o verbo não muda.

facts.label: Dizer não
facts.sub: Para recusar com educação, diga I’m sorry, I can’t. I have to work. Dar o motivo ajuda a outra pessoa a entender. Depois, ofereça outra hora ou um pequeno gesto.

pages.title: A big office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday at noon in a big office in Dallas. Phones ring and people talk quietly. Lia sits at her desk with two screens. Her coworker Kim stops by with her bag. Kim wants to go to lunch. Lia looks very busy.
“Hi, Lia! Do you want to have lunch with me?” says Kim. “I’m sorry, I can’t. I have to work.” says Lia. “Again? What are you working on?” says Kim.
